### Size

Predefined sizes are available from `xxsmall` to `xxlarge`, which are the recommended minimal (24px) and maximal (112px) sizes.

The Status badge is hidden on sizes smaller than `medium`.

<Canvas of={AvatarStories.Size} />

You can also resize the avatar to any size by setting `fontSize` css property.

<Canvas of={AvatarStories.Resize} />

### Src Set

And by using the `srcSet` prop, you can support multiple display resolutions.<br />
See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/HTML/Multimedia_and_embedding/Responsive_images
